fields.name: folder
fields.label: Books folder
fields.hint: The folder to look for .epub books in, on the TF card and in the frame's internal storage; empty for all of them. Downloads and exported notes go here (into Books when it is empty).

fields.name: file
fields.label: File to open
fields.hint: A file to open once, as "<storage>:<path>": what the Files app sends.

fields.name: fullScreen
fields.label: Full screen
fields.hint: The whole glass for the book: no bar of the frame's layout around it.

fields.name: languages
fields.label: Catalog languages
fields.hint: Which languages Project Gutenberg's books are listed in, as two-letter codes separated by commas; empty for every language.

fields.name: catalogs
fields.label: Your catalogs
fields.hint: OPDS catalogs to download books from, one a line: "Name | address" (a Calibre library, COPS, Kavita, a public feed). A login goes in the address. Lines starting with # are left out.

books.name: ePub reader
books.description: A book reader for EPUB books on the frame's card: a library with covers and progress, pages that fit the screen with the books' pictures, contents, bookmarks, highlights and notes, find, go to any place, text and layout settings, reading stats with time left at your pace, notes exported as Markdown and a Kindle My Clippings.txt, and free books from Project Gutenberg, Standard Ebooks and any OPDS catalog, downloaded on the frame.
